reviews.title: Love it!!!
reviews.comment: Perfect fit for my case and works great in keeping my processor temps fairly cooler than others I’ve tried. Software is easy to set up and the customizable screen is great. Definitely built to last and they’ve gained a customer for life.
reviews.author: robert mcgee

reviews.title: Cool LCD Display & 3 RGB Fan Coolers
reviews.comment:
My son, wanted this for his latest Computer Build from parts to finished glass display case. The LCD Display is an adorable addition to a glass case that displays a video or pic. I absolutely love the personalization of it.
And the three, RGB Fan Coolers are completely adjustable in many colors and patterns. And, the fans spin very fast or slow them down for compiter efficiency.
This item brought several personal touches to his Display Glass Case.
